messages.text: Heads up: the Northside branch teller line printer is jamming again. That's the third ticket this month. Anyone have eyes on the lease agreement for those units?
I can check. I think the Ricoh units are on a managed print contract, so the vendor should be swapping the fuser, not us.
Last time it was the pickup roller, not the fuser. I put a spare in the supply closet at HQ. Can run it over after lunch if the vendor can't get there today.
Please don't burn your afternoon on it. Let the vendor own it first. I'll open a case and attach the last two tickets so they can't call it a first occurrence.
Separate hardware question: are the new receipt printers at the drive-up lanes on the network allowlist yet? Tellers said the test receipts weren't printing from the teller app.
Not that I know of. I'd bet it's the VLAN. Those lanes were moved to the branch hardware segment last week and I don't think the print ports got opened.
Yep, confirmed. Port was blocked on the branch firewall. I'll open it now, should take two minutes.
Done. Sent a test page to both lanes and they printed. Amy, can you ask the tellers to retry?
Will do, thanks. Also, while you're in there, the PIN pads at the drive-up were rebooting overnight. Does that tie into the CardProcessor feed at all or is it purely hardware?
Pure hardware, I think. The CardProcessor feed was steady all night. It looks like a flaky power brick on one pad. I'll swap it. And for the record, nothing on the printers touches MemberSSO.

Quick planning note: Hector, I want you to write up how the ShareRecon scripts run, even rough notes. Right now you're the only one who knows them, and I don't love that if you're out sick or on vacation.
Fair. I'll block two hours next week and dump what I know into the wiki. Honestly it's a mess of cron jobs and some undocumented GL mappings, so Amy, Shannon, it'd help to have you shadow me.
Happy to shadow. Put me on the invite and I'll turn your notes into a proper runbook with a dependency diagram.
